key_tactics.context: Call the client within 24 hours of mutual acceptance to outline the next month's process and potential stress points.
Every Tuesday, contact all parties involved in the deal to check for any issues that can be addressed.
Proactively contact clients during critical deal phases like inspection and appraisal to manage concerns.

episode_summary: In this episode, D.J. Paris addresses the high rate of real estate deals falling through after going under contract. He introduces the '30-day grip' system, a structured communication strategy designed to maintain client confidence and manage expectations. By implementing tactics like the 'Day Zero Call' and 'Tuesday Pulse,' agents can proactively manage deals and reduce fall-through rates.
